prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: single-image Meshy 7 reference for a 3D civilian zombie character
Primary request: create one original source-free, full-body character reference of an unmistakably undead civilian for grounded Hearts of Iron IV WWII horror.
Subject: one fictional adult civilian zombie with a complete conventional human biped body. Make the undead identity immediate and clear in the face: very gaunt cheeks and temples, deep blackened hollows around cloudy pale eyes, a slack open mouth showing uneven teeth, and dry mottled gray-green skin. Give the hands an unmistakably desiccated, bony appearance with long thin clawlike fingers; keep both palms, thumbs, wrists, and every finger complete, distinct, separated, visible, and empty. The figure should look supernatural and lifeless, never like a healthy living civilian.
Clothing: ordinary mixed civilian clothing that fits 1936–1945: simple worn gray-brown button shirt, muted olive-brown trousers, and plain old civilian shoes. Use subtle cloth fraying at cuffs and hems. No uniform or added equipment.
Style/medium: grounded non-anime WWII horror character concept with realistic sculpted anatomy and textured materials, readable as a practical 3D character maquette; non-graphic supernatural horror.
Composition/framing: exactly one figure in a straight-on front view on a vertical portrait canvas, centered with clear margin from head to shoes. Relaxed symmetric rig-friendly A-pose with both arms angled slightly down from the shoulders, gently bent elbows, clawlike hands spread away from the torso, separated straight legs, a small gap between feet, and both complete shoes planted and fully visible. Preserve clear separation of arms, hands, legs, and feet. No cropping or dynamic action.
Lighting/mood: even neutral soft studio light to show anatomy and material layers; subdued, eerie mood.
Color palette: pale gray-green mottled skin, blackened eye hollows, cloudy eyes, restrained gray, olive, and brown clothing.
Scene/backdrop: request a genuinely transparent background with preserved alpha and transparent unused canvas; no floor, environment, cast shadow, or background illustration.
Constraints: one full-body undead subject, complete biped anatomy, complete separated fingers, empty hands, period civilian clothing, non-anime style, clear readable 3D form.
Avoid: healthy or handsome living-human expression, held object, extra figure, military uniform, modern gear, graphic horror, incomplete anatomy, merged fingers, exaggerated fantasy armor, anime/manga/chibi style, text, watermark, frame, border, collage, turnaround, side view, or multiple views.
